lines.source_visual_notes: Upper short handwriting starts to the right of large bold pictorial title. Loop-and-descender initial body retained as g, H-like fourth body retained as 4 with separate upper caron-like trace, later looped 6 has another upper trace. Final r-like body has a heavy upper angular mark retained as canonical ř; caron shape/attachment remains a source choice, not a roof-to-CH rule. Printed title is excluded.

Longer row below title, read left to right after 270-degree rotation. Initial cf32 has a small nearby upper-left speck near f, retained as a possible modifier observation rather than inserted glyph. Middle c and later s show acute-like detached strokes; repeated digit-like forms have upper marks explicitly retained. Final terminal5 has a shallow upper curved mark. Broad crop includes adjacent rows and printed title.

Short row below the preceding long row. Initial sequence includes H-like 4 with curved upper trace, h-like body with short upper upright stroke, and a looped6 with upper curved trace. Final c-like body has a detached acute-like stroke followed by a source dot. Nearby ink of row above is not reassigned as this row.

Lower separated row begins after ordinary compact date-like context excluded at its left. Initial looped body retained as g. Acute-like stroke above s-like form and curved mark above5 retained. Central thick overwritten cluster after th2 is unknown-mask ?, not repaired into a letter; adjoining small loop may be part of same unestablished cluster. Following5 has separate upper curved mark. Last group has H-like4 with angular upper mark and ends in a source exclamation.
